grade.reason: The agent's patch makes the same two functional changes as the merged patch. It adds xsrf_cookie_name="_mitmproxy_xsrf" to the Tornado Application settings in app.py, and it changes the frontend getCookie lookup to "_mitmproxy_xsrf" in utils.ts. The only difference is that the merged patch also adds an explanatory comment.

result:
mitmweb now uses a `_mitmproxy_xsrf` cookie for XSRF instead of the legacy `_xsrf`, so a stale HttpOnly `_xsrf` cookie no longer breaks option updates. I didn't run any tests, and I haven't checked the fix in a browser.

- **Backend:** `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py` now passes `xsrf_cookie_name="_mitmproxy_xsrf"` in the `Application` settings, next to the existing `xsrf_cookies=True` and `xsrf_cookie_kwargs`.
- **Frontend:** `web/src/js/utils.ts` now reads `getCookie("_mitmproxy_xsrf")` when building the `X-XSRFToken` header in `fetchApi`.

I left the existing `X-XSRFToken: undefined` assertion in `web/src/js/__tests__/utilsSpec.tsx` unchanged. It doesn't mention the cookie name, and the task said to keep the fix to backend and frontend cookie naming only.
